BiblicalUsage: Pere is the wild ass, the onager of the desert. Ishmael would be a wild man, his hand against every man, and Hosea says Ephraim went up to Assyria, a wild ass alone by himself, hiring lovers.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the wild ass is the picture of a man who will not be tamed: alone by himself, hiring lovers, and far from home.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
